subject.title: fix(cron): avoid false agent timeouts while execution lanes are busy

question: Should cron jobs be allowed to wait indefinitely for nested-lane admission, with no setup-watchdog bound, or should the product define a separate queue-wait policy?
rationale: The patch correctly distinguishes queue contention from runner setup, but it changes the availability boundary for a lane that never admits work; that timeout policy is product and operations intent rather than a mechanical code choice.

options.title: Accept queue-owned waiting
options.body: Approve the focused repair and treat lane admission duration as governed by the queue or scheduler rather than the setup watchdog.

options.title: Add a separate queue-wait policy
options.body: Keep the setup-timeout repair but define and test a distinct, intentionally configured or documented bound for prolonged lane starvation.

recommendation.title: Accept queue-owned waiting
recommendation.body: Approve the focused repair and treat lane admission duration as governed by the queue or scheduler rather than the setup watchdog.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR body records the focused maintainer direction and its separation from the related cancellation work.
